problem_text:
A municipality aims to devise a nutrient runoff mitigation strategy to decrease total phosphorus discharge from several agricultural drainage points. Initially, no intervention practices are in place.

The characteristics of each drainage point are as follows:
* For Field 1, runoff coefficient is 0.639, cultivated area is 285.226.
* For Field 2, runoff coefficient is 0.81, cultivated area is 273.731.
* For Field 3, runoff coefficient is 0.883, cultivated area is 261.483.
* For Field 4, runoff coefficient is 0.912, cultivated area is 112.651.
* For Field 5, runoff coefficient is 1.307, cultivated area is 208.764.
* For Field 6, runoff coefficient is 2.273, cultivated area is 187.71.
* For Field 7, runoff coefficient is 1.365, cultivated area is 81.293.

To abate discharge, several best management practices (BMPs) are available, each characterized by a specific capture efficiency:
* By implementing Practice1, nutrient loss will be reduced by 66%
* By implementing Practice2, nutrient loss will be reduced by 47%
* By implementing Practice3, nutrient loss will be reduced by 50%
* By implementing Practice4, nutrient loss will be reduced by 76%
* By implementing Practice5, nutrient loss will be reduced by 15%
* By implementing Practice6, nutrient loss will be reduced by 78%
* By implementing Practice7, nutrient loss will be reduced by 37%

Adopting a BMP for a drainage point incurs an implementation cost per unit of cultivated area. The cost matrix for all field–practice combinations is summarized below:

| Field \ Practice | Practice1 | Practice2 | Practice3 | Practice4 | Practice5 | Practice6 | Practice7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field 1 | 146.92 | 124.976 | 170.081 | 117.087 | 166.795 | 15.391 | 18.638 |
| Field 2 | 131.876 | 119.587 | 133.715 | 155.722 | 89.151 | 131.408 | 104.627 |
| Field 3 | 129.161 | 65.038 | 191.764 | 101.76 | 162.891 | 140.148 | 66.512 |
| Field 4 | 23.865 | 21.383 | 93.525 | 102.008 | 48.764 | 125.265 | 69.391 |
| Field 5 | 146.489 | 149.498 | 173.548 | 195.321 | 34.846 | 80.403 | 116.714 |
| Field 6 | 70.632 | 98.63 | 60.82 | 57.105 | 28.394 | 65.14 | 82.988 |
| Field 7 | 126.922 | 57.171 | 174.408 | 40.343 | 72.213 | 119.761 | 69.416 |

Please determine how to assign BMPs to each drainage point (points may adopt multiple practices concurrently), and note that a point may also remain partially untreated if necessary. The objective is to ensure that the total phosphorus discharge is reduced by at least a proportion P = 0.582 of the baseline load, while minimizing the aggregate implementation expenditure.
